messages:
alex: Heads up — post-promotion checks are failing in eu-west staging. deploy-bot flagged a postUpgradeJob hook timeout for payments-chart v2.14.1 :eyes:

deploy-bot: promotion stalled — hook "postUpgradeJob" failed (job payments-postupgrade) 1/3 pods, status CrashLoopBackOff. logs: `panic: failed to migrate index`

maria: ugh. is this the DB migration hook? did the migration image get the wrong tag?

ben: looks like the chart bump included a values change too: `values.payment.redis.enabled: false` vs previous `true`. could be traffic hitting an unexpected path during migration.

jordan: @alex can you paste the failed job logs? I pulled a snippet: `ERROR: duplicate index name "payments_idx"` — maybe the migration ran twice against the same DB replica.

alex: pasted full tail:
```
ERROR: pq: relation "payments_idx" already exists
goroutine 1 [running]:
main.runMigration()
	/.../migrate.go:86
```

maria: if it's duplicate index, rollback the migration and re-run with idempotent migration or run the preflight to drop index check. but we need to keep the promotion from reaching prod-like traffic.

ben: options: 1) rollback chart to v2.14.0 (safe) 2) pin cluster routing to fallback pool (manual) 3) run a manual quickfix migration that guards for index existence.

jordan: we don't have a certified quickfix and I don't want manual SQL in the middle of a release window. I'm +1 for rollback to v2.14.0. it's the fastest to get staging healthy.

alex: agree. any objections to doing helm rollback for the release and marking the chart version pinned until we patch the migration? we should also add a release note so folks don't re-promote.

sre-oncall: if you rollback, ensure the helm release name remains the same and bump the annotation `release-management/pinned: v2.14.0` so deploy-bot won't auto-promote again. I'll watch for eviction spikes.

maria: I'll prepare the rollback command and release note snippet:
```
# rollback to previous revision
helm rollback payments-release 3 --namespace payments-staging
kubectl annotate namespace payments-staging release-management/pinned=v2.14.0 --overwrite
```

ben: add a short release-note entry in the changelog channel: "Reverted payments-chart to v2.14.0 due to non-idempotent DB migration in v2.14.1. Do not re-promote until migration is patched."

deploy-bot: manual action recorded: rollback requested by @maria for release payments-release -> target chart v2.14.0. Promotion hold applied.

alex: who's taking the migration patch? @jordan?

jordan: I'll own a patch PR to make migration idempotent + add an explicit preflight check. ETA ~3 hours. I'll post the PR and we can re-run integration in a canary pool once it's green.

maria: rolling back now, will ping when done :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: helm rollback successful. release payments-release -> v2.14.0. Promotion hold remains until annotation removed.

sre-oncall: watching metrics. no spike in latency. good. once PR is merged and we run canary with the patched migration, we'll schedule a controlled re-promote outside the core change window.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll draft the release-note and mark the release as pinned. :shipit:
